the_invariant_instrument: the external classifier, hash-asserted, identical for every arm
what_this_is: w8 hub/encoder-loop: arm 'alone's OWN decoder, refit by the winner recipe verbatim from this arm's own frozen features. An unfrozen encoder's features are NOT the frozen decoder's input space (w8 rule 1), so the decoder follows the encoder and the JUDGE -- which reads images -- is what stays invariant across arms.
